title: Sneak Peek
notes: This page is HLS-only. No mp4, no promo.mp4, no progressive download.
`primary` is the stream the player loads first. Drop your own .m3u8 in here.
Anything in `fallbacks` is tried in order if the primary playlist fails to load.
A URL pasted into the page's source bar overrides this file and is remembered in localStorage.
